messages:
paul_sales: Quick help needed — POC for LedgerX (tenant: ledgerx-7) hit 429s during a live demo. They were running embeddings and chat concurrently. Route errors on /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat. Can someone triage?

lee_eng: Do we have the exact error payloads and any request ids? Models?

paul_sales: They sent: `{"error":"429","type":"rate_limit","msg":"global_quota_exhausted"}` for chat and `{"error":"429","type":"rate_limit","msg":"per-route cap"}` for embeddings. Models: embeddings-lite and redwood-chat-8k. No full request ids, timestamp ~2026-03-20T14:05:30Z.

nina_oncall: Pulling logs for ledgerx-7 now. My guess: concurrent heavy embeddings consumed the tenant global pool, then chat hit per-route soft cap.

harry_sre: Log excerpt: ```[14:05:28Z] tenant=ledgerx-7 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=5200 global_left=1200 -> 200 OK
[14:05:30Z] tenant=ledgerx-7 route=/v1/chat tokens=1600 global_left=0 -> 429 global_quota_exhausted
[14:05:31Z] tenant=ledgerx-7 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=4000 global_left=0 -> 429 per-route-cap
```

harry_sre: Confirmed: global pool was exhausted by overlapping embedding calls.

lee_eng: Short-term options: 1) apply temporary global token bump (small TTL); 2) ask customer to pause embeddings for a minute; 3) serialize heavy calls in demo.

paul_sales: Customer prefers a silent fix — they want demo to finish. They approved a short bump.

nina_oncall: Applying conservative bump: `/ops tenant update --tenant ledgerx-7 --global-burst +8000 --ttl 15m` -> op_ledgerx_03.

ops-bot: Operation op_ledgerx_03 started by nina_oncall.

harry_sre: After bump logs show success: `[14:05:44Z] tenant=ledgerx-7 route=/v1/chat tokens=1400 global_left=7600 -> 200 OK`. Customer reports demo completed.

lee_eng: Post-demo recommendations for sales: estimate peak concurrent tokens (embeddings are large), prefer serializing heavy calls, or allocate a reserved global pool for mixed-workload POCs. Consider offering a demo config that reserves X tokens for interactive routes.

paul_sales: Thanks — I'll send the summary and the CLI steps we used. Closing thread unless anyone wants to add KB items.
